:::{#thm-kl-divergence-cross-entropy}
#### KL divergence is cross-entropy minus entropy

For $X$, $p$ and $q$ as in @def-cross-entropy,
suppose the [cross-entropy](#def-cross-entropy) $\crossentropyf{p}{q}$ and the [entropy](#def-entropy) $\entropyf{X}$ are finite.
Then the [KL divergence](#def-kl-divergence) is

$$\kldivf{p}{q} = \crossentropyf{p}{q} - \crossentropyf{p}{p}.$$

:::

::: proof

By the definition of [cross-entropy](#def-cross-entropy),
$\crossentropyf{p}{q} = \E{\surprisalunderf{q}{X}}$.
By @cor-cross-entropy-entropy,
$\crossentropyf{p}{p} = \entropyf{X} = \E{\surprisalunderf{p}{X}}$.
Both expectations are finite by assumption,
so [linearity of expectation](expectation.qmd#thm-linearity-expectation) applies:

$$
\ba
\kldivf{p}{q}
&= \E{\surprisalunderf{q}{X} - \surprisalunderf{p}{X}} && \text{(definition)} \\
&= \E{\surprisalunderf{q}{X}} - \E{\surprisalunderf{p}{X}} && \text{(linearity of expectation)} \\
&= \crossentropyf{p}{q} - \crossentropyf{p}{p}. && \text{(the two expectations above)}
\ea
$$

:::
